answer: Make each identity pay a cost no swarm can amortize: every epoch hands an agent a fresh puzzle, seeded like shifting sand across a dune, so yesterday's solution is worthless today. One honest agent solves it as readily as a falcon spots prey, but a thousand fakes each owe the same new work. The verifier reads the result the way you read pigment on a page: cheap to check, costly to forge at scale. Sybils drown in redundant effort.
